'''The Key to Me''' is the English ending theme for ''[[PK26|Pikachu, What's This Key?]]''. It is included on the [[Pokémon Movie Music Collection]] album.

What do you like to do?
Who do you want to be?

We jump around 'n' round 'n' round 'n' round

We jump around 'n' round 'n' round 'n' round
